text:
Mia Chen: Quick idea  one-page "Lightning Guide" for CS handoffs: single health score, 3 risk flags, and very short customer-facing steps for caching/batching/streaming. Keep it super short.

Rajiv Desai: Yes. Split signals into realtime (stream errors), short-term aggregates (5m failed-call %), and daily snapshot (activation %). Each maps to exactly one CS action.

Elena Park: For the score, keep it 0-100 and transparent. Use weights: activation 40, call_success 30, prefill 20, latency 10. Interpretation: <45 at-risk, 45-69 watch, >=70 healthy.

Victor Ramos: Customer checklist (3 bullets): 1) What we watch: latency, prefill success, stream stability. 2) What we do: extra prefill attempts, adaptive batch tuning, graceful stream fallback. 3) Quick wins: enable non-personal prompt cache, cap token length, try smaller batch size.

Mia Chen: Include a tiny reproducible snippet for SEs: `health = round(min(100, 0.4*activation + 0.3*success + 0.2*prefill + 0.1*latency_score))`

Rajiv Desai: Ops triggers (one-liners): stream_err > 2% -> open enablement ticket; prefill < 80% -> trial with smaller batch & longer window; latency_95p > 1500ms -> recommend batch tuning.

Elena Park: Feedback flow: send a 48h form (3 Qs: prefill improved? Y/N; regressions? text; rating 1-5). Persist as event for next daily snapshot.

CS Bot: Sample telemetry snippet for guide (inline): {tenant: acme-corp, health_score: 62, drivers: [prefill:72, stream_err_pct:1.6, latency_95p_ms:1100], ts: 1758000123}

Victor Ramos: Failure-mode note: on cache-miss storm, route to small dedicated pool or throttle prefill jobs. SRE quick command we include: `prefill-cli start --tenant acme-corp --batch-size 16 --window 2h`.

Mia Chen: I'll assemble the 1-page Lightning Guide + one-paragraph customer summary and share for review Thu morning. Thanks all.
